params.name: REAPER 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/reaper-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Reaper fifty years on, after the Boeing MQ-28 Ghost Bat: still the gun with a plane round it. A seven-barrel rotary cannon in the open under a chined nose, clamped, with a ribbed and slotted breech housing, gas diverters and a feed chute back to a drum fairing with a lit rounds strip; a bubble on an armoured tub bolted down both flanks; a targeting turret, a refuelling receptacle, aperture windows; turbofans high on the rear fuselage with serrated nozzles and IR shrouds; the straight thick wing with its gear standing half out of leading-edge pods; twin fins canted out; a missile, a glide bomb and a targeting pod on pylons; a datalink array and satcom dome on the spine. Two loyal wingmen ride conformal in lit cradles on the outer wing panels and fly in formation off each wingtip while the weapons are armed (the wingmen channel). A variant of the gunship mesh, worn as the REAPER 2076 factory edition.
